tide_mode.notes: Daily (1D) tide. ema: sign of the EMA(13) slope. macd: sign of the MACD histogram (12/26/9) slope. both: the two must agree, otherwise the tide is flat.

wave_osc.notes: 4H oscillator. force2 is Force Index(2) divided by (4H ATR x SMA20 of 4H volume). stoch is slow %K(5,3) in points. elder_ray is Elder-ray power measured in 4H ATR.

wave_threshold.notes: Units depend on wave_osc. force2: a pure number; long when normalized Force Index < -threshold (0 leaves only the sign). stoch: slow %K points; long when %K < threshold, short when %K > 100 - threshold. elder_ray: multiples of 4H ATR; long when bear power < -threshold x ATR and is rising.

wave_block_impulse.notes: When true, a 4H Impulse against the trade blocks the wave. A cold Impulse also blocks.

ripple_expiry_bars.notes: 30m bars a stop order stays working, counted from the arm bar. 48 bars is 24 hours.

stop_lookback_bars.notes: How many closed 4H bars the stop looks back over. The stop sits beyond that window's extreme.

stop_atr_buffer.notes: Extra distance beyond the 4H extreme, in 4H ATR(14) units.

min_stop_atr.notes: Minimum 1R, in 4H ATR(14) units. A closer stop is dropped (stop_too_close_atr).

t1_r.notes: First target, in R. t1_share of the position closes here.

t1_share.notes: Fraction of the position closed at T1. The remainder trails until the 10R cap or a tide exit.

be_after_t1.notes: After T1 fills, move the stop to the entry from the next 30m bar.

trail_atr.notes: Chandelier distance for the runner, in 4H ATR(14), updated when a new 4H bar closes.
